# Sukun (سُكون)

> Sukun is your mental wellbeing companion (مرافقك في رحلتك النفسية): an Arabic-first daily wellbeing app with original audio journeys, breathing exercises, habit tracking, mood check-ins, gentle reminders and cognitive games. It is in early access, coming soon to iOS and Android, with a waitlist open at https://www.sukunlife.app/#waitlist.

The site is a single page, in Arabic by default. Add `?lang=en` for English, which is rendered in the browser.

## What Sukun offers

- Breathing exercises: a full 4-7-8 exercise and others, with a visual rhythm.
- Audio journeys: guided audio experiences and meditations on relationships, confidence and change, voiced by a certified coach.
- Daily habits: small habits to build or to quit, with streaks that never blame you for a missed day.
- Mood tracking: one question a day, which draws your Sukun Map without scores to compare yourself against.
- Gentle alarms and reminders: timely, in the tone of a friend rather than a counter.
- Cognitive games: short games for focus and relaxation.

## Good to know

- Every line is written in Arabic first, in a warm Gulf tone, then recorded. English is a translation, never the original.
- Sukun is a daily wellbeing app, not a replacement for therapy. It does not diagnose or treat, and it points people in real distress to support resources in their country.
- Check-ins are private; Sukun never sells user data.
